Emits is empty because the terms this widget's provenance asserts are written by src/raster-provenance.ts, while implementation.definition names src/core.ts#TYPES; the release declares what the defining module asserts, which is nothing of its own.

changes.description: The country is not asked for again. The Inspector kept a "Country for population data" list, after the study area that already states the country (the practitioner, 2026-11-10, with a screenshot). It is gone; Configure… offers the WorldPop population raster for the study area's country, its year and its download, and asks for the country to be set on the study area where none is stated. The Inspector keeps Name, Inputs, Settings and Result.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. 0.6.0: tests/raster-point-registration.test.mjs checks a point grid read as cells around its nodes, and a window keeping each value at its node; EGM2008 read from cdn.proj.org at the Manila gauge gives 43.009 m bilinearly, PROJ's value. 0.7.1: tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs checks the Inspector asks no country, and Configure… offers WorldPop for Botswana from the area, or says to set the country on the area; Chromium.
